title: Pairwise Difference Learning for Classification
abstract: arXiv:2406.20031v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pairwise difference learning (PDL) has recently been introduced as a new meta-learning technique for regression. Instead of learning a mapping from instances to outcomes in the standard way, the key idea is to learn a function that takes two instances as input and predicts the difference between the respective outcomes. Given a function of this kind, predictions for a query instance are derived from every training example and then averaged. This paper extends PDL toward the task of classification and proposes a meta-learning technique for inducing a PDL classifier by solving a suitably defined (binary) classification problem on a paired version of the original training data. We analyze the performance of the PDL classifier in a large-scale empirical study and find that it outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of prediction performance. Last but not least, we provide an easy-to-use and publicly available implementation o

translated_title: 面向分类的成对差分学习
translated_abstract: 成对差分学习（PDL）最近被引入作为一种用于回归的新型元学习技术。与以标准方式学习从实例到结果的映射不同，其核心思想是学习一个函数，该函数以两个实例作为输入，并预测相应结果之间的差异。给定此类函数，对查询实例的预测由每个训练样本推导得出，然后取平均值。本文将PDL扩展到分类任务，提出了一种元学习技术，通过在原始训练数据的成对版本上求解一个适当定义的（二分类）问题来构建PDL分类器。我们在大规模实证研究中分析了PDL分类器的性能，发现其在预测性能方面优于最先进的方法。最后，我们提供了一个易于使用且公开可用的实现。
tldr: 本文将成对差分学习（PDL）从回归扩展到分类任务，提出通过在成对训练数据上求解二分类问题来构建PDL分类器，在大规模实证研究中其预测性能优于现有最先进方法。
en_tdlr: This paper extends pairwise difference learning (PDL) from regression to classification, proposing a meta-learning technique that induces a PDL classifier by solving a binary classification problem on paired training data, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in a large-scale empirical study.
